About IRS

Leadership

Reza Khan

Founder & Director

Reza Khan is the Founder and Director of Innovative Research Solutions (Pvt.) Ltd., an independent research and policy advisory organization focused on Pakistan. He holds an MPhil in Government and Public Policy from the National Defence University, Islamabad.

His areas of interest include public policy, economic and institutional analysis, governance, development, and evidence-based policymaking. His work focuses on examining Pakistan's policy and institutional challenges through research, analysis, and practical policy solutions.

At IRS, he leads research and advisory initiatives aimed at generating rigorous, independent analysis and translating evidence into practical insights for businesses, institutions, and decision-makers.

Academic Qualification
MPhil in Government and Public Policy
National Defence University, Islamabad
